TRANSACTION - FUNCTIONAL DESCRIPTION: Transaction to execute the creation of the pricing rules
EXECUTION FLOWS - DETAILED DESCRIPTION: 1. Input and validations: the transaction receives pricingRuleRequest, logs it and sends it to ABKOR001.executePostPricingRules(pricingRuleRequest). In the invoked library, validatePostPricingRule validates the effectiveDate range, checks whether another pricing rule already exists with the same detail set or with overlapping variable payment methods, and resolves the descriptive value of each detail from its entityType and id before any insert. 2. Decisions and branches: if the end date is before the start date, if an exact duplicate exists with the same fee, if a variable pricing rule exists with the same details and a different fee, if variable payment methods overlap, or if a detail id cannot be resolved for its entity type, the library throws PricingRuleException and skips persistence. If the advice list is empty, assignSeverityError returns without changing severity; otherwise it sets Severity.EWR. 3. Libraries and invoked methods: the transaction obtains ABKOR001 with getServiceLibrary(ABKOR001.class) and invokes executePostPricingRules. That implementation gets the request header user, obtains audit and pricing rule identifiers, inserts the audit log, persists the pricing rule through PricingRuleMapper.mapToInsert and then inserts each pricing rule detail with its own audit record. 4. Errors and follow-up actions: any PricingRuleException raised in the analyzed POST flow is converted into addAdviceWithDescription(code, description) inside the library, and the transaction then reviews this.getAdviceList() to assign Severity.EWR when at least one advice exists. 5. Outputs and assignment conditions: when persistence finishes successfully, the library returns the same PricingRuleDTO with the generated id and resolved detail values, and the transaction assigns it to pricingRuleResponse.
